title: Widower's Nest (Quest)
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Discover

Quest Description: Sally Forth, Dungeon Runner, to Widower's Nest! Then Return to the Townston Commander in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Travelers? Check

Zone: The Widower's Nest

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Sally Forth, Dungeon Runner, to Widower's Nest! Then Return to the Townston Commander in Townston.

Offer:

We've recently purchased the Widower's Nest, which was a huge hit back when it was first introduced. Now, with the release of all the next gen dungeons, we were able to get the Widower's Nest slightly used at a great bargain! A great break for us. Hopefully we will be able to get some of the old diehard Dungeon Runners back with this old school dungeon.

Most Dungeon Runners don't know this, but there are two ways to get into the Widower's Nest Base Camp. A portal on Vergrim's Vexation - Level 5 and the teleporter that transports adventurers one way into Widower's Nest Base Camp.

Go into the Widower's Nest and make sure it at least starts up. When you have done that you should return to me, the Townston Commander, here in Townston.

Turn-in:

Well done. The lands of the Widower are ripe for reselling!

Objectives:

  • Locate Widower's Nest Base Camp
  • Locate Widower's Nest

Level range: 20–40
